items.result: Phase 1 DB, 1,440 archetypes, original acceptance/scenarios, and tests are preserved.
Nemotron was acquired directly without user file provision.
Raw/canonical locations, version, release checksum, and nine shard SHA-256 values are stored.
24 active domains cover all mandatory areas and map to Phase 1 categories.
All 24 domains have exactly 16 axis applicability decisions (384 rows).
Every domain has taxonomy, 20 features, 10 behaviors, and source maps.
Every domain meets the configured minimum depth and discloses evidence constraints.
No demographic-only domain is marked plain complete; acceptance uses domain axes.
Latent dimensions and 24 revisioned segmentation models are materialized.
Music/audio and small-business vertical slices exist through DB, REST, CLI, and export.
Clean Phase 1 plus additive Phase 2 and idempotent Phase 2 reapplication pass at 30/58 tables.
Eligibility is stored for all 1,440 Phase 1 parents.
All 120 eligible parents have 3–6 primary subtype allocations.
Base shares and child counts reconcile with errors far below required tolerances.
Overlapping tags are separate, non-additive, and carry sum warnings.
All 90 subtypes have ordered Low/Base/High and entity units.
All 90 subtypes persist population, interpretation, and targetability confidence.
Evidence, assumptions, inferred disclosure, prohibited inference, gaps, and validation plans are present.
All 90 active subtypes have activation profiles.
24/24 domain end-to-end acceptance cases passed.
10/10 exact semantic parent decomposition cases passed; scenario prevalence is disclosed.
10/10 required cross-domain cases returned guarded exploratory estimates and passed.
All 276 pairs store joint support, method, dependence/independence status, uncertainty, and caveats.
Draft 2020-12 contract validates all payloads and creative briefs work via REST/CLI.
One aggregate observation and held-for-review posterior update executed with bias diagnostics.
Required registries, models, subtypes, allocations, confidence/gaps, profiles, and validation data export as CSV, JSON/JSONL, and Parquet.
Coverage matrix and cross-domain association report are generated from current DB rows.
Unit, integration, acceptance, reconciliation, coverage, privacy, artifact, and migration tests pass.
A new operator can build, add/inspect domains, recluster, cross-query, update feedback, validate, promote, and roll back.
No Phase 2 TODO/FIXME/stub or schema-only feature remains; evidence-poor values are explicit E-grade scenarios or not_estimable, never placeholder zeroes.

limitations: Nemotron personas are synthetic hypotheses, not a probability sample.
Required parent cases 2–10 use exact query definitions but E-grade scenario parent prevalence.
Versioned mixed-unit cross-domain cases use documented decision-maker bridges and E-grade semantic overlays; generic unbridged mixed-unit queries remain not_estimable.
Minimum combined stability is 0.169 and therefore remains explicitly exploratory.
The website-less restaurant case lacks an observed owner-age-60-to-69 by website-presence joint and retains a wide D/E-grade uncertainty treatment.
